audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[4].side and phases[5].side read "Skill" while content win[4]/win[5] say Samira; phases[6].side reads "Skill" while win[6] says Seraphine. Rows 0-3 already agree (Samira).
audit.why: Wild Rush dashes and the melee-Q combo keep Samira ahead through her first item; her W (Blade Whirl) blocking your Q/Encore and Inferno Trigger's execute extend that through level 6. Only at 2+ items does your ranged kit and set-up Encore flip it.
audit.corrected: phases[4,5].side -> Samira, phases[6].side -> Seraphine; ratings/whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns calls Blade Whirl matchup-defining with no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Blade Whirl is 30-22s depending on rank; Wild Rush (E) is 20-12s and refreshes on a champion kill; her R has effectively no cooldown (5s, free cast) once she's in combo. These numbers change how a reader times a step-up.

Blade Whirl (W) destroys enemy missiles including Seraphine's Q and Encore — this is already correctly stated across dosFull/breakdown/report. Samira's E is a dash (deniable by grounding/walls) and her R is a channel with no listed interrupt flag, matching Riot's text of a rapid-fire volley rather than a true channel.

edits.after: Inferno Trigger executes and her Blade Whirl (W) blocks your all-in at level 6.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: Your W shields and heals for free HP in every duo exchange — cast it before her Wild Rush dash lands, not after.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.

edits.before: - Samira Blade Whirl: matchup-defining — Deletes every projectile for a second — hold your key shots until the whirl is spent. Check it before every step-up. - E Beat Drop is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Blade Whirl (W, 30-22s) destroys your Q and Encore projectiles for its duration — hold key shots until it's spent. - Wild Rush (E, 20-12s) refreshes on a champion kill, so a fed Samira can dash twice in one fight. - Her R (5s CD, free) has no real cooldown once she's in combo — the combo itself is the timer.
